steps.content: Twenty minutes later, all the survivors are gathered in the wheelhouse, including you and Ragnar.
The cramped space now holds a dozen people, bodies pressed against each other as you force the thin air into your lungs and let it out in careful breaths. You are the only souls left on the ship.
No one dares to speak. The loudest sound in the frozen air is the dull thumping of hearts against ribs.
The collision has stopped, but Pylgia, still concerned, stays underwater to keep watch.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I tried to do the bandages. Is it... okay?

You keep your head down, too guilty to meet her eyes, and busy yourself with dressing Shin's injuries. The cuts look terrible, but thankfully, they're just flesh wounds. A child's attack can only do so much harm.
But still, you're gnawed by doubts.
Here, trapped in this lonely vessel on the dark sea... has your mind become so fragile that a simple taunt from Ragnar could drive you to madness?

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Thank you.
Shin interrupts your brooding. With a faint smile, she rises gracefully, smoothing the creases from her dress. Her composure seems to dispel the suffocating dread in the air.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: We've cleared the danger zone. If we keep going in the direction you gave us, we should, in theory... reach land soon.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: "Mantis"
Her voice is steady, but sorrow passes in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: "Mantis"

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: I didn't realize he was under so much pressure. I killed him...

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Don't blame yourself, Shin. It wasn't your fault.
Your gaze drifts to Ragnar in the corner. He leans against the wall, his eyes vacant, a dry, broken laugh rattling in his throat.
Again, words spill from your lips, almost beyond your control.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We've already found the source of all this, haven't we?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We can't let this happen again...
Before you can finish, Shin's hand presses gently on your shoulder.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: I've checked. Ragnar's body is fine, but he's lost all response to external stimuli. In other words, he no longer has any negative emotions that can be manipulated.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: I know what you're worried about... but this isn't the time to bloody our hands with a crewmate's life. It's for everyone's sake, not just his.
A brief silence fills the wheelhouse.

You survey the room. Captain Edmond has taken the helm, his expression grim. Reid, who witnessed Sigmund's end alongside you, clutches a safety axe and stands guard over Laura silently, like he's trying to atone for something.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But...
Your voice is raw, forced from the back of your throat. You've seen too many tragedies, lost too many important companions. You're... running out of courage for another gamble.
Shin takes your hand, her palm warm and steady.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: If we let fear overcome reason at a time like this...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: I don't know for sure what would happen, but I have a feeling it would be a fate worse than death... and you probably understand that better than any of us.
Noticing your silence, Shin offers a familiar smile.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: The expedition's faced impossible odds before. And every time, we pulled through by supporting each other.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: This time, it'll be no different.
After a moment, Pylgia's fragmented words crackle through the silent radio.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: You... saved me...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: This time... I'll continue to believe in you...
Every eye in the wheelhouse turns to you, some confused, others hopeful, but all filled with trust.
You close your eyes, your chest heavy yet warm. That dark feeling of despair seems to have lifted a little.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll get us out of here, but...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Until we're truly safe, no one can let their guard down.
Weapons clutched tight, the crew watches Ragnar with wary eyes, isolating him in an empty corner of the room.
Through the portholes, the shadow of land is much closer than before. But you know the real danger never comes from above the waves.
